title: llm-kit prompt file, version 1 (parsed form)
description: What a reader returns for one prompt file. The text grammar (UTF-8, one leading byte order mark removed, CRLF and lone CR read as LF, at most one ---PROMPT--- line, slots {{name}} with name [a-z][a-z0-9_]*) is fixed by the shared cases, not by this schema. Written in llm-scripting-kit.json-schema-subset/v1. Contract and shared cases: docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

header.description: The text before the marker line; null when the file has no marker line.

slots.description: The body's slot names in order of first use, each once.

sha256.description: The lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the body encoded as UTF-8.

source.description: Where the text was read from, such as a path. Not part of the file.
